item.title: HypoPG 1.4.5 is out!
item.description:
Tainan, Taiwan - Sun 1 Nov 2026

HypoPG 1.4.5

I'm pleased to announce the release of the version 1.4.5 of HypoPG, an extension adding support for Hypothetical Indexes, compatible with PostgreSQL 9.2 and above.

Changelog

Bug fixes:

  • Fix long standing thinko in hypo_estimate_index (Julien Rouhaud)
  • Fix relid handling in hypothetical indexes, that could lead to a crash (Julien Rouhaud)

Links & Credits

Thank to the users who reported bugs, they are all cited in the CHANGELOG file.

HypoPG is an open project. Any contribution to build a better tool is welcome. You just have to send your ideas, features requests or patches using the github repository at github.com/HypoPG/hypopg.

Links

  • Download: github.com/HypoPG/hypopg/releases
  • Bug tracker: github.com/HypoPG/hypopg/issues

item.title: E-Maj 5.0.1 : Major Security Update.
item.description:
We are very glad to announce the E-Maj 5.0.1 version.

E-Maj is a PostgreSQL extension which enables fine-grained write logging and time travel on subsets of the database.

This version mainly fixes a vulnerability encountered in all previous versions, allowing some users to gain superuser privileges under certain circumstances.

Users are strongly encouraged to update their installed version as soon as possible.

E-Maj 5.0.1 is compatible with Postgres 14 to 19 versions. Emaj_web 5.0 is compatible with emaj extension 3.0 to 5.0 versions.

The full documentation is available on line. The core extension is available at pgxn.org for installation or github.org for development.

The Emaj_web client is also available at github.org.

Have fun with E-Maj !
